summary: The KB/root/evolution distinction and wrapper conventions are clear, but the host KnowledgeBase type conflicts with the value-carrying KnowledgeBase used in ADRs 0006 and 0010, which blocks MaterializeRoot and evolution checking signatures.

questions.text: ADR 0004 defines host KnowledgeBase as an unparameterised repository/prefix locator, but ADRs 0006 and 0010 use a value-carrying host KnowledgeBase CheckedValue / KnowledgeBase Value.
questions.reason: One name cannot be both, and MaterializeRoot has no other input for Root.recipes; ADR 0004: 'data KnowledgeBase = KnowledgeBase { repository :: Repository, prefix :: TreePath }' vs ADR 0006: 'MaterializeRoot :: RootContract -> CodeSnapshot -> KnowledgeBase CheckedValue' and ADR 0010: 'value :: KnowledgeBase CheckedValue'.

questions.text: ADR 0004 says EvolutionWorkspace carries a Before (revision and schema) and an After target schema, but ADR 0010 defines it as only a KB and an EvolutionId.
questions.reason: If the workspace value holds schemas, listing and resolving need the compiler; ADR 0004: 'EvolutionWorkspace is an editable proposal whose Before contains a Git revision and the schema from that commit' vs ADR 0010: 'EvolutionWorkspace carries only its key and owning KB; its location is derived.'

questions.text: Does the host Root record its provenance (accepted revision or candidate evolution), or must callers carry that alongside it?
questions.reason: Outputs and responses must identify the selected revision; ADR 0004 calls Root a descriptor of 'schema, executable meaning/dependency identities and materialized fact tree' but its record has no such field, while ADR 0018 says 'JSON responses identify their kind and selected revision/evolution'.
